jobs.title: QA Automation + Manual Engineer- Canada Remote
jobs.description:
Job Title:
Sr. QA Automation+ Manual Engineer

Location:
Canada (Remote)

Position :
6+ Months Contract

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled QA Automation Engineer
to design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and scripts to ensure high-quality software delivery. The ideal candidate will work closely with developers, product owners, and DevOps teams in an Agile environment to ensure functional, regression, and performance testing are automated and scalable.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain automation test scripts and frameworks
Perform functional, regression, smoke, and integration testing
Collaborate with developers and business teams to understand requirements and acceptance criteria
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Identify, document, and track defects using tools like JIRA
Execute automated test suites and analyze test results
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies (stand-ups, sprint planning, retrospectives)
Ensure test coverage for web, API, and backend applications
Support UAT and production validation when required
Follow best practices for test automation and QA standards

Required Skills & Qualifications

Strong experience in QA Automation testing
Hands-on experience with automation tools such as:
Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, TestNG, JUnit

Programming experience in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#
Experience with API testing (Postman, RestAssured, SOAP UI)
Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab)
Knowledge of version control systems (Git)
Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
Strong understanding of STLC and SDLC
Excellent communication and documentation skills

Nice To Have (Preferred)

Experience with performance testing tools (JMeter, LoadRunner)
Experience in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP)
Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
Exposure to containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Not Applicable

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting
